definitions.gloss: patriot; committed activist; man of high purpose
definitions.explanation: A person who devotes himself to a great cause, especially to his country. Most often used of the activists of the Bakumatsu period who worked to overthrow the shogunate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{維新|いしん}→維新：13869_ishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{志士|しし}だった。
examples.english: He was one of the patriots of the Restoration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{坂本龍馬|さかもとりょうま}→坂本龍馬：31007_sakamotoryouma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{幕末|ばくまつ}→幕末：12531_bakumatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{志士|しし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Sakamoto Ryōma is known as one of the patriots of the late shogunate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧{志士|しし}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つくる⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけた。
examples.english: The young patriots risked their lives to build a new nation.

notes:
Literally "a man of resolve" (⟦{志|こころざし}→志：06655_kokorozashi⟧, aspiration + ⟦{士|し}→〜士：28352_shi⟧, samurai, gentleman). The word carries strong admiration and is used almost only in historical contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{幕末|ばくまつ}→幕末：12531_bakumatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{志士|しし}: the activists of the late shogunate
- ⟦{維新|いしん}→維新：13869_ishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{志士|しし}: the patriots of the Meiji Restoration
- {勤王|きんのう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{志士|しし}: loyalists to the emperor

USAGE:
Not used of present-day activists, who are {活動家|かつどうか}; calling someone a {志士|しし} today sounds grand or tongue-in-cheek.
